shortDescription: Tests reachability using ping from VyOS network devices

options.name: count
options.description: Number of packets to send to check reachability.

options.name: dest
options.description: The IP Address or hostname (resolvable by the device) of the remote node.

options.name: interval
options.description: Determines the interval (in seconds) between consecutive pings.

options.name: size
options.description: Determines the size (in bytes) of the ping packet(s).

options.name: source
options.description: The source interface or IP Address to use while sending the ping packet(s).

options.name: state
options.description: Determines if the expected result is success or fail.

options.name: ttl
options.description: The time-to-live value for the ICMP packet(s).
